title: Portfolio blind-spot governance
objective: Turn seven known portfolio blind spots into inspectable evidence gates without treating process readiness as proof that an external dependency has been satisfied.
closureRule: Closure progress is reported separately and is not a passing gate. Collaborator confirmation, unfamiliar-reader validation, and media rights require real external evidence.

criteria.name: Collaborator corroboration
criteria.question: Do job-critical role and outcome claims have bounded confirmation from people who directly worked with Jamie?
criteria.closureDefinition: At least three public-safe, permission-scoped collaborator confirmations cover distinct projects and specify Jamie's action, what became usable, collective context, and reuse boundary.

criteria.name: Contemporary implementation proof
criteria.question: Can a present-day employer inspect recent paid technical, product-operations, implementation, or AI workflow work?
criteria.closureDefinition: At least three current-role proofs from 2022-2026 are corroborated, outcome-bearing, and approved for an application surface.

criteria.name: Unfamiliar-reader validation
criteria.question: Can unfamiliar hiring readers identify Jamie's role, strongest proof, and next action without coaching?
criteria.closureDefinition: At least five bounded sessions across two target reader groups meet the comprehension, recall, navigation, and interview-intent thresholds.

criteria.name: Visual proof and rights
criteria.question: Can readers inspect the work through rights-cleared, contextually appropriate visual evidence?
criteria.closureDefinition: At least three visual proofs across three projects have cleared rights, resolved consent, factual captions, source lineage, and an approved display destination.

criteria.name: Claim-bearing source maturation
criteria.question: Are high-consequence public claims backed by explicitly close-read sources rather than archival volume or metadata alone?
criteria.closureDefinition: Every source supporting front-door claims is dispositioned, and at least 80 percent are explicitly close-read or replaced by a stronger source with the remainder bounded.

criteria.name: Outcome evidence
criteria.question: Does the portfolio distinguish outputs, observed use, outcomes, and causal contribution?
criteria.closureDefinition: At least four major case studies carry a corroborated outcome or durable-use claim, with output, use, outcome, and causality represented as separate fields.

criteria.name: Audience-specific compositions
criteria.question: Can the governed bank compose distinct application arguments without changing the underlying facts?
criteria.closureDefinition: Four internal briefs define distinct audiences, goals, selection criteria, evidence palettes, exclusions, and next actions without widening public approval.
